title: selaginella uliginosa
intro: Selaginella uliginosa, commonly known as swamp spikemoss, is a type of ancient plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella uliginosa include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
